entities.name: Donald McGinley
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Donald Francis McGinley was a Democratic politician from Nebraska who served a single term in the United States House of Representatives from 1959 to 1961 and as Nebraska's 32nd lieutenant governor from 1983 to 1987 under Governor Bob Kerrey.
